messages:
alex: @deploy-bot kicked off staged rollout v2026.3 -> 5% eu-west. No schema changes. Quick sanity check dashboards: https://dash.redwood/incidents/r-329a

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] rollout id r-329a started: v2026.3 -> 5% eu-west (profile: low-latency). Monitors: latency, 5xx, kv-cache-oom. In-progress.

maria: seeing a slight p95 increase on embeddings in eu-west — from ~420ms to ~650ms on a small sample. Not yet correlated to 5xxs.

sam: can you paste the sample trace ids and whether nodes are fully warmed?

maria: sample traces: trace/1887, trace/1888. Warm nodes: 3/4. Quick logs:
```
kvcache-miss-rate: +12%
latency-tail spike @ 2026-03-23T14:02:13Z
```

jia: watching. any auto-fallback configured for this route?

ops-lead: routing policy has automatic fallback to pinned stable v2026.2 if p95 > 1.5x baseline OR 5xx increase > 0.5%. Current delta: p95 ~1.55x for embeddings, 5xx at 0.12% (baseline 0.08%). Borderline.

alex: propose we PAUSE the rollout and pin eu-west back to v2026.2 while we investigate. Collect more traces and run prompt-eval. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: +1 pause and pin. Prefer graceful rollback of the eu-west canary rather than full abort. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] issuing pause on r-329a. Traffic hold engaged. To pin: `rbctl pin r-329a eu-west v2026.2 --reason "p95 embedding regression"`

maria: pin applied (rbctl returned ok). I'm creating a prompt-eval to diff outputs between v2026.3 and v2026.2 on the same request set.

jia: when we resume, suggest warming 2 extra nodes and enabling kv-prefetch on the canary route to reduce miss rate.

ops-lead: agreed. Proposed plan:
1) pin + rollback eu-west to v2026.2 (done)
2) collect traces & run prompt-eval (maria)
3) warm + kv-prefetch on canary route (infra)
4) re-run 5% after QA sign-off with stricter guardrails
Any objections?

alex: no objections. I'll update the release notes and add a short incident note in the changelog.

sam: thanks — tagging @oncall for visibility :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: [DeployBot] rollback executed: r-329a eu-west -> v2026.2 (complete). Traffic restored to baseline.

maria: metrics back to baseline. Leaving thread open for postmortem and action items (eval diff + infra warm).
